Part 2&3 物品 OBJECTS

Describe a short-term job you want to have in a foreign country

描述一个你想在国外做的短期工作

⚠️ AI 范例，仅供学习 — IELTS 口语全程独立完成，背诵照搬 AI 答案会被考官识别为背稿。

Part 2 话题卡片

Describe a short-term job you want to have in a foreign country

  • Where it is (它在哪里)
  • How you know of it (你是怎么知道它的)
  • What the job is (这份工作是什么)
  • And explain why you want to do it (并解释你为什么想做它)

问题与答案

Cue CardDescribe a short-term job you want to have in a foreign country

I'd like to talk about a short-term job I'd love to do in a foreign country, and that's teaching Chinese. I've been thinking about this for a while, and it seems like a perfect fit for me. First of all, where it is: I'd like to do this in a country where Chinese isn't widely spoken, maybe in Europe or Southeast Asia, like Thailand or France. The idea is to spend a few months there, teaching basic Chinese to local students or adults who are interested in the language. As for how I know about it, I've seen a lot of videos and articles about Chinese teachers working abroad, and some of my friends have done volunteer teaching programmes. They said it was a great experience, because you get to travel, meet new people and share your culture at the same time. That really inspired me. What the job involves is teaching everyday Chinese, like greetings, numbers and simple conversations, and sometimes introducing Chinese culture, such as festivals and food. Since I'm a native speaker, I can handle the language part easily, and I'm good at explaining things clearly. The reason I want to do it is that it combines travel with something I'm actually good at. I've always wanted to see more of the world, and teaching Chinese would let me earn a little money while I'm there, instead of just spending. Looking back, I think it would be a meaningful way to spend a few months, and it might even help me decide what to do in the future.

讲的是想在国外做的短期工作：教中文。地点：中文不普及的国家，欧洲或东南亚，比如泰国、法国，待几个月，教当地学生或成人基础中文。怎么知道的：看过很多中国老师出国教书的视频和文章，有朋友做过志愿教学项目，说既能旅行、认识新朋友又能分享文化，很受启发。工作内容：教日常中文，问候语、数字、简单对话，有时介绍中国文化如节日和美食；作为母语者语言部分轻松，而且我擅长清楚讲解。为什么想做：把旅行和自己擅长的事结合起来，一直想多看看世界，教中文还能边赚点钱；可能还会帮自己决定未来的方向。

Q2What short-term jobs do young people do in other countries?

Young people often take short-term jobs like working in cafés, restaurants or shops, especially during holidays. Some also do farm work, like picking fruit, or teach languages, such as English or Chinese. These jobs are popular because they don't require long-term commitment and they allow young people to earn money while travelling. I think the main appeal is that they offer a chance to experience life in another country without staying there permanently.

年轻人常做短期工作，比如假期在咖啡馆、餐厅或商店打工；也有人做农活，如摘水果，或教语言，如英语、中文。这些工作受欢迎是因为不需要长期承诺，还能边旅行边赚钱。主要吸引力是能体验另一个国家的生活，又不用永久留下。

Q3What challenges do young people face when working abroad?

There are several challenges. The most obvious one is the language barrier, since it's hard to communicate with colleagues and customers if you don't speak the local language well. Another challenge is adapting to a different culture, including food, working habits and social rules, which can be stressful at first. On top of that, young people may feel lonely or homesick, especially if they're far from family and friends. So I'd say working abroad requires both language skills and emotional strength.

挑战有几个。最明显的是语言障碍，当地语言不好就很难和同事、顾客沟通；另一个是适应不同文化，包括食物、工作习惯、社交规则，一开始会有压力；此外年轻人可能感到孤独或想家，尤其远离亲友。在国外工作既需要语言能力也需要心理承受力。

Q4What are the benefits of working for an international company?

Working for an international company has quite a few benefits. First, employees get to work with people from different countries, which broadens their view and improves their communication skills. Second, international companies often offer better training and clearer career paths, since they follow global standards. Third, the experience looks good on a resume and can open doors to opportunities abroad. Having said that, the pressure can be higher, but on the whole I think the benefits outweigh the drawbacks.

在国际公司工作好处不少：第一，能和来自不同国家的人共事，开阔眼界、提升沟通能力；第二，国际公司通常培训更好、职业路径更清晰，因为遵循全球标准；第三，这段经历写在简历上很好看，还能打开海外机会。不过压力可能更大，但总体利大于弊。

Q5What personal skills are required to work in an international company?

I think the most important skill is communication, because you need to work with people from different backgrounds and express your ideas clearly. Language ability is part of this, but so is the ability to listen and understand different perspectives. Flexibility is also essential, since international companies often have different working styles and time zones. On top of that, being open-minded and willing to learn helps a lot, because you'll constantly meet new situations.

最重要的技能是沟通，因为要和不同背景的人共事、清楚表达想法；语言能力是其中一部分，倾听和理解不同视角的能力同样重要。灵活性也必不可少，国际公司常有不同的工作风格和时区；此外开放心态和愿意学习很有帮助，因为会不断遇到新情况。

Q6What kind of work can young people do in foreign countries?

Young people can do quite a wide range of work abroad. Many start with service jobs, like working in restaurants, hotels or shops, which are easy to find and don't require special qualifications. Others do teaching, especially teaching their native language, or work as au pairs looking after children. Some young people also do internships or seasonal work, like working at ski resorts or summer camps. I think the choice depends on their skills and how long they plan to stay.

年轻人在国外能做的工作范围很广。很多人从服务行业开始，如餐厅、酒店、商店，容易找且不需要特殊资质；也有人做教学，尤其是教母语，或做互惠生照看孩子；还有人做实习或季节性工作，如在滑雪场或夏令营。选择取决于技能和计划停留的时间。

Q7Why are some people unwilling to work in other countries?

There are several reasons why people are unwilling to work abroad. The biggest one is probably family, since many people don't want to be far from their parents, spouse or children. Language and cultural differences also make people hesitate, because they worry about not fitting in or struggling to communicate. On top of that, some people are satisfied with their jobs at home and don't see the need to take such a big risk. So I'd say it's a combination of practical and emotional concerns.

人们不愿出国工作的原因有几个。最大的可能是家庭，很多人不想离父母、配偶或孩子太远；语言和文化差异也让人犹豫，担心融入不了或沟通困难；此外有些人对国内的工作满意，觉得没必要冒这么大风险。这是实际和情感因素的综合。
